description: North Central Province - Notifying that Mr. Athmadale Aluthwatthe Gedara Manju Sri Aluthwattha of Lankapura Pradeshiya Sabha and Mr. Thebuwaththe Gamaralage Ananda Sri Dharmasena of Medirigiriya Pradeshiya Sabha have been removed from the Posts of Chairman with immediate effect
reasoning: This gazette contains both specific people (Athmadale Aluthwatthe Gedara Manju Sri Aluthwattha and Thebuwaththe Gamaralage Ananda Sri Dharmasena) being removed from their positions, AND detailed portfolio responsibilities of the Chief Minister (Minister of Provincial Law and Order, Finance and Planning, Local Government, Provincial Road Development, Rural Infrastructure Facilities and Special Project, Tourism, Education, Information Technology and Cultural Affairs). This combination of named individuals with detailed ministerial responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
